name: Semgrep
tagline: Semgrep is a fast, open-source static analysis tool for finding bugs and security vulnerabilities across 30+ languages. Its AI-assisted rule writing and Semgrep Assistant features automatically triage findings, write custom rules from plain-English descriptions, and explain vulnerabilities with remediation guidance.
